shares.revokeBody:
The shared version is erased from the server: the link answers “not found” for everyone who has it, at once and for good. The row stays here, dated, and so does the checkpoint in the project's history.

Sharing the project again gives a NEW link — this one does not come back.

share.confirmTitle: Share this project as it is now?
share.confirmBody:
The link plays this version, kept as a checkpoint in the project's history: what you change afterwards is not part of it. Every VST track is rendered first, on a machine that has the plugin, which can take a while.

Anyone with the link will be able to listen to it and see the tracks, the chains and the modules' parameters — with no account. The names of tracks, markers and modules, and the text of the notes, are part of that.

The link stays valid until you revoke it, from the project's row on the home page.
